pages.title: Cherenkov Lamp
pages.text: A lamp of Cherenkov quartz with glowstone at its heart, so the blue Cherenkov glow is amplified into a strong, clean light. It is the colour of a reactor pool, and as calming. It never flickers and never warms, and the blue makes every surface it touches look freshly cleaned.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Cherenkov quartz alone glowed too faintly to light a room. Adding glowstone dust to a block of it pushed the glow into a proper lamp.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Precision Lithography.
